description: Redevelopment of the existing office/industrial building to provide a mixed B1(C), B2 and B8 floorspace with ancillary offices, yard, car parking and landscaping
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - C13	The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as B1 (c), B2 and B8 and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 5 - Storage [activities] shall not take place anywhere on the site except within building[s].
Condition : 6 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing No. 02 P5 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to  shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 9 - No soakaways shall be constructed in contaminated ground

Condition : 10 - The construction of the site drainage system shall be carried out in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development commences

Condition : 11 - A landscape management plan, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for the green belt area adjoining the site shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority prior to the occupation of the development.  The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 12 - Before the development hereby commences:
The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination.  A detailed site investigation report shall be prepared and submitted to the LPA for comment.  The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contaimination based on the proposed end use of the site.
A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the LPA, for written approval.
Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied:
The LPA shall be notified immediately if additional contaimination is discovered during the course of the development.  A competent person shall assess the additional contaimination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the LPA for approval.
The agreed scheme for decontamination, including amendments, must be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the LPA for approval.
Condition : 13 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within Block A or B hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 14 - The units provided in Block C and D hereby permitted shall remain as individual units unless prior written consent is obtained from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 15 - Surface water drainage works shall be carried out in accordance with details which shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before development commences.
